packageRules.description: Markdown tooling moves together — prettier and markdownlint gate the same checks, so review them in one PR.
Action digest bumps are mechanical and the workflows re-run on the PR, so they need no staged rollout.

nuget.description: templates/Directory.Packages.props and templates/global.json are CONTENT, not this repository's dependencies — nothing here builds against them. They are maintained by the refresh-dotnet-versions skill, which resolves each pin against nuget.org, checks target-framework compatibility, reads release notes on a major bump, and updates the 'verified on <date>' header comment. A bot bumping the version string alone would satisfy none of that while making the header lie, and audit-freshness would stop being able to tell a reviewed pin from an unreviewed one.
